candidates.name: Lymphomatoid Granulomatosis

candidates.name: Angioimmunoblastic T-cell Lymphoma

contradict_spans: Respiratory viral panel, SARS-CoV-2 PCR, fungal pneumonia work-up were negative
candidates.why: The combination of respiratory symptoms, diffuse rhonchi, and systemic lymphadenopathy, as well as the presence of atypical lymphoid cells, suggests a diagnosis of Angioimmunoblastic T-cell Lymphoma.
candidates.protected_reason: This diagnosis requires a high index of suspicion and may be overlooked in favor of more common causes of respiratory symptoms.
